target_profile.note: Compatibility labels below distinguish upstream support claims, offline validation, physical testing, and testing on this exact target.

status_definitions.recommended_candidate: Strong feature fit and current upstream release; still requires project-side installation and regression validation before one-click default.
status_definitions.conditional: Useful, but target-specific compatibility, safety, or backend interaction must be checked first.
status_definitions.optional: Specialist feature, not required for the core system and not installed by default.
status_definitions.dependency: Runtime dependency installed only when a selected module requires it.
status_definitions.alternative: Competing implementation; do not install concurrently with the selected provider.
status_definitions.review: Discovery record not yet approved for installation.

records.name: Wi-Fi Turbo
records.author: juanjsebgarcia
records.target_notes: 3.65 is explicitly listed as physically tested by the author. Keep Wi-Fi on prevents automatic standby and increases battery use; expose sleep/battery consequences clearly. Quick Menu module is optional.

records.name: vitastream
records.author: devnoname120 and xerpi
conflicts: other USB Video Class kernel plugins
records.target_notes: Firmware-aware module identity checks and offline compatibility coverage are documented. Retail physical validation cited by the author is on 3.60; do not claim a 3.65 hardware test. Install only one USB video kernel backend. Audio routing remains resident until reboot after stop/removal.

records.name: Turbo Storage
records.author: juanjsebgarcia
records.target_notes: Latest v0.4.0 was physically tested by its author on PCH-1000 firmware 3.60. Firmware 3.65 is listed as alpha; the reported 3.65 success concerns older v0.3.0 on PCH-1100. Our PCH-1000 + 3.65 + YAMT + SD2Vita combination is unverified. v0.4.0 removed internal-storage acceleration. Keep all acceleration off until validated; backup both SD and memory card first.

records.name: Bluetooth Turbo
records.author: juanjsebgarcia
conflicts: Bluetooth audio patches that hook the same stack (review before enabling together)
records.target_notes: Author's physical test is one PCH-1000 on 3.60; 3.65 is declared but not physically tested. Optional codec add-ons are unofficial, opt-in and separately licensed/notices apply. Existing paired headsets must be removed and paired again after enabling.

records.name: VitaBrightEX
records.author: Zushikina-kun
conflicts: other brightness/LUT driver plugins; verify before combining
features: OLED red-tint correction for affected panels
records.target_notes: Strong match for PCH-1000 OLED. The 1.3 release explicitly leaves the OLED hardware LUT untouched by filter math; on OLED the companion UI intentionally limits controls to safe invert/reset actions. Validate the installed panel/LUT selection before altering files. Firmware support is NID-based, but no exact PCH-1000 3.65 test is recorded in this catalogue.

records.name: PSVshellPlus
records.author: GrapheneCt
conflicts: NoPowerLimits and other CPU/GPU frequency controllers
records.target_notes: Latest tagged release found is v1.4 (2023). It remains a useful established control surface but is not a recent release; keep optional and verify 3.65 compatibility and conflicts before enabling. Never run multiple overclock managers together.

records.name: reVita-extended
records.author: JSilva6
conflicts: reVita and other overlapping controller remappers
features: input profiles and macros (verify exact release feature set)
records.target_notes: A maintained extended fork is listed by the community catalogue. Keep as a distinct alternative to original reVita, not a simultaneous install. Firmware compatibility and exact binary manifest require upstream review before packaging.

records.name: FTP for Vita
records.author: M-Essa11
records.target_notes: Starts disabled after each reboot. Requires QuickMenuReborn for standalone install; the VPK installer bundles it. Do not combine with FTP Everywhere. Adapter should manage start/stop and status, not assume FTP is always active.

records.name: Caffeine for Vita
records.author: M-Essa11
records.target_notes: Starts disabled after reboot and preserves manual standby. VPK includes QuickMenuReborn 2.5; standalone installation requires it already installed. Keep optional because it can affect battery and suspend behavior.

records.name: LiveArea NoLimits
records.author: devnoname120
features: raises LiveArea page and icon limits
records.target_notes: Useful only for users exceeding stock LiveArea limits. Not a Settings control; inventory and offer as an optional shell extension.

records.name: Screenshot NoShard
records.author: devnoname120
components: Screenshot NoShard plugin binary (verify release package)
records.target_notes: Quality-of-life feature; useful but not essential. Keep optional and avoid stacking with screenshot plugins that redirect the same paths.

records.name: rePatch reLoaded
records.author: SonicMastr
records.target_notes: Keep as the preferred modern rePatch line for game mod/data redirection, but it is not a general Settings feature. Validate per-title compatibility and do not install alongside the legacy rePatch binary.

records.name: kubridge
records.author: TheOfficialFloW and Bythos
features: DynaRec feature extender for compatible homebrew
records.target_notes: Install only when a selected application/plugin explicitly requires it. Do not show as a user-facing tweak.

records.name: ioPlus
records.author: FAPS Team / CelesteBlue
features: I/O compatibility layer required by selected plugins
records.target_notes: Use the standardized AutoPlugin II dependency build and resolve it only for dependents. Preserve it when another installed plugin still requires it.

records.name: YAMT
records.version: installed baseline; verify exact installed build
records.author: SkGleba
records.target_notes: Already part of the target console setup. Detect and preserve the existing configuration; never silently reinstall or replace. YAMT is the chosen storage provider for this device; migration to StorageMgr must be explicit and transactional.

records.name: StorageMgr
records.author: CelesteBlue and Yoti
records.target_notes: Alternative storage driver only. Not offered for installation while YAMT is active. Include only as an explicit migration option after backing up storage configuration and confirming mount mappings.
